# lazy-val

`lazy-val` 1.0.5 (MIT) is a dependency of `electron-updater`. Its package.json names the MIT
licence and the author, Vladimir Krivosheev, but neither the npm package nor the repository
carries a licence file. `LICENSE` holds the standard MIT text with that author as the copyright
holder, so the notices can include it.

Check this file again when the `lazy-val` version changes.
